navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Columbia College Chicago

stats.notes: CDS C1: international first-year applicants 1,491, admitted 689 (46%), enrolled 14, versus a 74% overall admit rate. Admission is test-free, so no SAT/ACT data are reported (C9 is blank). No early decision or early action; no waitlist. GPA distribution and 3.43 average are C11/C12 (all enrolled first-years). Factors are C7 'general' admission (programs with specific criteria, such as BFA/BMus portfolios and auditions, are decided on the work submitted). Undergraduate enrollment 4,346 and 221 nonresident undergraduates are CDS B1/B2 (fall 2025).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8 table marks could not be read; Columbia's freshman page says admission is entirely test-free, and C7 lists test scores as not considered.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5: tuition $35,498 (12-18 credits, two semesters), required fees $1,892 (includes the estimated U-Pass), food and housing $19,466, books $1,950, transportation $1,100 plus other $3,240 (other_usd = $4,340). CDS H6: 178 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid averaging $10,942 (total $1,947,625); the CDS marks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid as available to nonresidents.
